verdict.rationale: ClickHouse ships an official CLI, clickhousectl, installable via `curl https://clickhouse.com/cli | sh`. It manages local ClickHouse versions and servers, executes queries, provisions and manages ClickHouse Cloud resources and ClickPipes, and installs official ClickHouse agent skills into coding agents, which directly serves AI-native workflows. clickhouse-local adds a further first-party command-line SQL tool. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of clickhousectl specifically (community praise covers only clickhouse-local).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: With clickhousectl you can: * Install and manage local ClickHouse versions * Launch and manage local ClickHouse servers
Install the official ClickHouse agent skills into supported coding agents
Execute queries against ClickHouse servers * Set up ClickHouse Cloud and create cloud-managed ClickHouse clusters
